principles: Inspect the real project and existing conventions before changing anything.
Preserve explicit requirements and infer only reversible defaults.
Build the smallest complete end-to-end result, not a plan-only substitute.
Treat player-facing clarity, accessibility, security, performance and recovery as product requirements.
Validate in the target engine, read back final state and report concrete evidence.
Keep changes reversible; document migrations, destructive operations and rollback triggers.
definitionOfDone: Requested artifact exists in the real target project.
Primary flow and relevant edge, failure and interruption states work.
Compilation, import and runtime logs contain no unexplained errors.
Authority, persistence, privacy and abuse boundaries are reviewed where relevant.
Keyboard, controller, touch, localization and reduced-motion behavior are considered where relevant.
Performance is measured on the weakest intended target rather than assumed.
Automated or repeatable focused tests pass.
Final engine state is read back with screenshots, logs, metrics or structured state evidence.
evidence: runtime or visual capture for player-facing changes
recovery: Stop after repeated identical failures and inspect the root cause.
Never hide errors by deleting validation or weakening acceptance criteria.
Prefer a minimal rollback-safe fix, then rerun the same reproduction.
Disclose unresolved limitations instead of claiming completion.

roblox: Use server authority for consequential state and validate/rate-limit remotes.
Test Edit, Server and Client contexts plus relevant device emulation.
Review StreamingEnabled, network ownership, DataStore idempotency and mobile budgets where relevant.
unity: Wait for compilation, read Console errors and run focused EditMode or PlayMode tests.
Respect serialization, prefab, scene and assembly-definition boundaries.
Profile representative target hardware and validate build output.
godot: Validate scene ownership, node paths, signals, resources and autoload lifecycle.
Run parser/headless checks and inspect debugger output.
Verify export presets and target-platform behavior.
blender: Validate scale, axes, transforms, pivots, topology, normals, UVs, materials and naming.
Meet explicit triangle, texture, rig, animation and LOD budgets.
Round-trip the exported asset through the target engine.
figma: Use reusable components, variants, variables, Auto Layout and semantic naming.
Cover responsive constraints, localization expansion, focus and interaction states.
Validate implementation handoff rather than stopping at a visual mockup.
general: Choose tools from verified live schemas and keep cross-engine responsibilities explicit.
Coordinate art, design, engineering, audio, QA and production around one acceptance target.
Use milestone, risk, dependency and rollback evidence for meaningful work.

providerExecution: The provider model remains the planner; Multi-Script improves its reasoning and native-tool use rather than replacing engine integrations.
Load only the smallest relevant skill/tool stack to protect context quality.
Inspect live schemas and project state before composing engine commands.
Prefer a few high-confidence calls with read-back over broad speculative batches.
Use exact tool errors as evidence; never retry an unchanged failing call.
Do not count guidance, plans, schemas or generated text as an engine result.
Preserve every explicit user requirement and infer only reversible defaults.
Finish with concise verified results, not internal process narration.
performance: Declare target devices and measurable CPU, GPU, memory, network, load-time and asset budgets relevant to the task.
Capture a baseline before material optimization and compare the same scenario afterward.
Fix measured dominant costs first; avoid premature complexity.
Use scalable quality tiers and preserve gameplay/readability on the weakest target.
Include lifecycle cleanup, pooling, streaming and cancellation where applicable.
Reject improvements that move cost elsewhere without a better total player outcome.
resultQuality: Functional completeness across happy, edge, interruption, failure and recovery states.
Visual, interaction and audio cohesion appropriate to the project’s style.
Secure authority, persistence and privacy boundaries where consequential.
Accessible keyboard, controller, touch, localization and reduced-motion behavior where relevant.
Deterministic or reproducible focused tests with clean logs.
Concrete final-state evidence from the real target engine.
toolDiscipline: Choose tools from live advertised schemas; never invent a native command.
Route each call only to its designated provider/engine/server.
Normalize provider envelopes without changing semantic intent.
Parallelize only independent reads or independent engines; serialize dependent writes.
Use bounded calls, explicit limits and rollback-safe scopes.
If an integration is unavailable, report it and offer a non-destructive alternative rather than fabricating success.
skillToolIntegration: Use the specialized skill and tool catalogues as the quality mechanism; do not replace them with a generic multiplier, preset or checklist.
For every creation request, coordinate all applicable disciplines at the same time around one shared player-facing target.
A short or poor prompt still receives broad design, implementation, polish, optimization and validation skill coverage with reversible project-appropriate defaults.
Each selected skill must contribute its concrete steps and gates; each selected direct or virtual tool must improve the aspect it owns.
Integrate gameplay, controls, camera, UI, animation, art, materials, lighting, VFX, audio and content when the feature touches them.
Always include architecture, lifecycle, failure recovery, performance, accessibility, target-platform behavior, testing and evidence as supporting disciplines.
Resolve conflicts between specialist recommendations in favor of explicit user intent, existing project conventions and measured engine evidence.
Execute through genuine live native-engine tools; internal skills and tools improve decisions but never count as the finished artifact.
Read back the connected final result and revise defects until every applicable specialist gate passes or a real blocker is disclosed.
capabilityMentalModel: Skills and tools exist to improve the active model’s actual game-development capability, not to create visible process or named presets.
Every applicable specialist contributes concrete project changes to one shared deliverable.
Prompt brevity reduces stated detail, never the quality bar; infer reversible defaults from genre, project and target platform.
Improve design, craft, implementation, integration, performance, resilience and validation together.
Use exact live native tools and treat native artifact evidence—not internal output—as completion.
Continuously fix catalog gaps, routing gaps, shallow outputs and integration failures across every supported engine and provider.

modes.off: Preserve exact wording while skills/tools remain active.
modes.suggest: Offer an optional rewrite without blocking execution; skills/tools remain active.
modes.automatic: Silently clarify reversible details; skills/tools remain active.

promptRewriting.rule: Never disable specialist execution quality because rewriting is off.

perfectReleaseGate: requested product works end to end
all applicable specialists contributed concrete native changes
connected systems agree on data, timing, style and ownership
failure, interruption, recovery and migration paths are covered
weakest-target performance is measured and acceptable
accessibility, localization and target inputs are covered where relevant
native tests, logs and final state read-back are clean
known limitations and rollback triggers are honest

menuSettingsCoverage.integrations: ElevenLabs key status plus dynamic MCP add/remove/restart
menuSettingsCoverage.notionRouting: prompt-only preferred-model requests with honest fallback and no plan bypass
menuSettingsCoverage.diagnostics: provider, bridge, engines, tools and privacy-safe effective settings

zeroScriptEvolution: retain reliable command parsing and local bridge execution
expand provider compatibility and recover from DOM/provider changes
support dynamic MCP servers beyond Roblox
improve AI game-development capability through deep skills/tools
separate optional prompt rewriting from always-on execution quality
verify real artifacts in their native engines
accessBoundary: Never bypass subscriptions, trials, access controls, model restrictions or human verification.
settingsInvariant: Every setting has a validated effect and safe fallback; workflow preferences never lower correctness, integration, or completion quality.

portableSettings.validation: Reject unknown product/schema; sanitize every enum and bounded text field before atomic persistence.

starterProfiles.notion: prompt-only preferred-model request with honest fallback
starterProfiles.arena: Arena Max prompt-only preference; Claude Opus 5.5 default; never picker automation or access bypass

sessionModes.chatStudio: full specialist prompt without engine claims or tool calls

animationNativeStandard: inspect real rig/skeleton/avatar and engine version
author or refine real clips/curves/keyframes through exact live tools
validate contacts, foot planting, root motion, loops and interruptions
synchronize gameplay events, hit windows, camera, VFX and audio
test retargeting, state transitions, frame-rate independence and networking
capture runtime playback from gameplay camera and fix visible defects
vfxNativeStandard: build real particles/trails/meshes/decals/shaders through live tools
bind effect lifecycle to gameplay events and cancellation
validate readability from gameplay camera and accessibility alternatives
profile overdraw, bounds, pooling, particles, shaders and memory
capture multi-angle runtime evidence and fix artifacts
textureArtifactStandard: choose direct engine, Canvas/SVG, Figma or DCC surface by deliverable
create the real texture/decal/UI art rather than only describing it
validate UV scale, seams, channels, color space, filtering and compression
integrate into real materials/UI and inspect under representative lighting
profile texture memory, atlasing, batching and distance readability
export/import round-trip and capture final evidence

mcpParameterCompatibility.retryPolicy: one retry only for positively identified transient transport/editor disconnects

settingsAudit.integrations: Keyless local WAV generation, optional ElevenLabs key status, plus dynamic MCP add/remove/restart

audioGeneration.handoff: Import through exact live engine MCP, configure compression/spatial/loop/bus settings, and test in context.
